description: Na₂PS₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. There are two inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six S²⁻ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing NaS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 12-14°. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.84-2.90 Å. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six S²⁻ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing NaS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 12-14°. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.87-2.96 Å. P⁴⁺ is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three S²⁻ atoms. There are two shorter (2.02 Å) and one longer (2.03 Å) P-S bond length. There are two inequivalent S²⁻ sites. In the first S²⁻ site, S²⁻ is bonded to four Na¹⁺ and one P⁴⁺ atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing SNa₄P trigonal bipyramids. In the second S²⁻ site, S²⁻ is bonded to four Na¹⁺ and one P⁴⁺ atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing SNa₄P square pyramids.
